svg.title: Published and awarded
svg.desc: Papers: NurdleDNA: An Edge-AI and Smart IoT Inline System for Source-Level Microplastic Detection (13th IEEE ICSIMA 2026); Comparative Analysis of Classical and Quantum Vibration Sensors Under Radiation-Induced Environmental Stress (12th EECSI 2026). Awards for NurdleDNA: First Prize, UOWD Innovation Fair 2026; AURAK Excellence Award, Tier 1, the only UOWD team to qualify; James Dyson Award 2026, qualifier.
